source: The server builder decides which of the two paths is in use, rather than the flag doing so directly. A server builder declares whether its build is a pass of its own, run after the app build, or an environment of the app builder's build. {0} declares it from {1}, and a server builder with no build pass of its own (such as {2}) declares that Vite is building everything.
text: C'est le server builder qui détermine lequel des deux chemins est utilisé, et non le flag directement. Un server builder indique si son build constitue une passe à part entière, exécutée après le build de l'application, ou un environnement du build de l'app builder. {0} l'indique depuis {1}, et un server builder sans passe de build propre (comme {2}) indique que Vite construit tout.
